blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The transport group Manibela will extend its protest action / jeepney strike in Metro Manila until Wednesday, November 25, its chairman Mar Valbuena said. Manibela launched the initial two-day strike on Monday to protest the supposed replacement of Land Transportation Office (LTO) chief Assistant Secretary Markus Lacanilao. “Until tomorrow … we will have no trips scheduled,” Valbuena said in Filipino in a video, addressing jeepney drivers who are also seen in the video behind him. On the second day of their strike, Manibela held their program under the Nagtahan Flyover near Malacañang. “Currently, we have no trips because of the protest […]...
